items.question: What total number of subtle channels is held to exist within the body?
premises: The stated quantity is seventy-two thousand.
The channels are located within the body.
These channels are traditionally remembered as established.
items.inference: The body is held to contain seventy-two thousand subtle channels.
items.plain_english: Seventy-two thousand channels are traditionally held to exist in the body.
